title: Course filter in 課程目錄: all / in progress / finished
todo_items: v05 showed a 全部 / 進行中 / 已完成 filter above 我的課程 (課程目錄). Removed at migration because the backend has no rule for a course's study state. To do: define 進行中 / 已完成 (e.g. every lecture's plan steps done = 已完成; any study activity = 進行中), expose it on GET /api/courses (or the plan), add the seg back in renderCourseDirectory (studio-app.js) and remember the choice as a preference. Test the rule in tests/.
